paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim, beginning of chapter 5, and Chagigah, chapter 3, halakhah 2, reporting in the name of R' Yochanan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רפ״ה gives beginning of Kilayim chapter 5, rejecting an older end suggestion; פ״ג ה״ב explicitly gives Chagigah chapter 3 halakhah 2. No named edition is independently checked.
The heading figure is the understood reporter in Yochanan’s name; no teaching content or specific linkage to just one cited locus is supplied. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
